purpose: Synthetic creative and regression fixtures for DREAM Visual Grammar 1.0; not psychological ground truth

dreams.text: I was walking in a forest when the path split into three. I could see each direction clearly.
I opened seven doors, but every door took me back to the same quiet room.
narrativeAnchors: back to the same quiet room

dreams.text: I was talking to my mother in a crowd that kept growing larger. I could still see her clearly.
I was swimming under dark water. Then I rose to the surface and saw warm sunlight everywhere.
I was falling from a tower and felt afraid. Someone reached out and caught me. Then I felt safe.
The streets of a city bent sideways around me, then the buildings broke into small pieces.
I climbed a staircase that never ended. Each landing looked exactly like the one before it, over and over.
I only remember a distant light inside a large empty, quiet space. Nothing else was there.
